description: Institutional Copilot Chat Basic with enterprise data protection; prompts and responses are not used to train foundation models. CTLT limits what instructors can require students to share in course use of Copilot for Organizations to U1 Low Risk information. Follow UBC authorized-use/privacy/security rules; access is not assessment permission.
howToObtain: Sign in to Microsoft 365 via m365.cloud.microsoft or copilot.microsoft.com using UBC CWL credentials and verify the green 'Protected' badge.
costToUser: Included as part of UBC Microsoft 365 licensing for eligible students, faculty, and staff at no additional cost.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Copilot Chat (Basic) is available to eligible UBC students, faculty, and staff through UBC’s Microsoft 365 environment, subject to service availability and institutional controls.
Copilot Chat (Basic) and M365 Copilot (Premium) provide enterprise data protection for prompts and responses, and that prompts and responses are not used to train Microsoft foundation models.

What students can be instructed to share with the tool: Limit data sharing to information that is “Low Risk” according to UBC’s Information Security Standard U1 .

This information may be freely disclosed or would cause minimal harm if disclosed. Examples include names and work contact information of UBC faculty and staff members; information that is posted on a public UBC website; and research of a non-personal, non-proprietary nature.

description: Launched October 15, 2026 as a paid annual Workday cost-recovery subscription for eligible UBC faculty and staff only, adding organizational M365 data grounding; not available to students, contractors, emeriti, or guest accounts.
howToObtain: Eligible faculty and staff request via the UBC Self-Service Portal with manager approval and departmental Workday worktag funding.
costToUser: Paid annual subscription for eligible faculty and staff only (launched October 15, 2026), funded by faculty or department on a cost-recovery basis via Workday worktag; not available to students.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: These services are offered on a cost-recovery basis: your faculty or department pays the annual subscription cost, with your manager’s approval, through UBC’s established funding processes in Workday.
Premium subscriptions are available to UBC faculty and staff. They are not available to students, contractors, emeriti and guest accounts.

description: Under UBC CTLT PIA guidance for tools instructors require in a course (updated February 17, 2026; distinct from voluntary student choice; reconciling ubc:chatgpt), ChatGPT 5 without an account is assessed low risk for required course use with caution, but does NOT protect personal information (shares entered data outside Canada and may store IP address) and never grants assessment permission without express instructor authorization.
howToObtain: Access ChatGPT in a browser without registering or logging into a personal account when permitted or required with caution by a course instructor.
costToUser: Free web access without user registration (CTLT PIA assessed February 17, 2026 as low risk for required course use with caution; does not protect personal information).

description: Under UBC CTLT PIA guidance for required course use (updated February 17, 2026; reconciling ubc:chatgpt), instructors must NOT require students to sign up for or use ChatGPT 5 with an account because sign-up requires personal information and shares entered data and device data outside Canada; this guidance addresses mandatory course requirements rather than voluntary student use by choice. This restriction concerns compulsory course adoption, not a general ban on voluntary use; assessment permission remains separate.
howToObtain: CTLT says instructors cannot require account sign-up or use for a course. This course-requirement guidance does not determine permission for voluntary student use or establish an institutional licence.
costToUser: No institutional cost or licence determination established here; the cited CTLT restriction concerns compulsory course sign-up/use.
